local_learn.observation: The benchmark Candidate is relevant as evidence discipline, but the child model must remain overlay-free so the Candidate does not become an experimental confounder or reveal evaluator intent.

result.baseline_need: Use the Root-frozen 12-case protocol, fixed all-cases-pass threshold, immutable public request, and no-Candidate child context as the baseline. The Candidate trial changes only how the parent Execute preserves and maps evidence, not the tasks, expected answers, child instructions, scorer, or threshold.
evidence_to_collect: exactly two frozen redacted tasks for each of the six criteria
seed and nonce commitments plus the public-suite and child-request digests created before execution
proof that every executor-facing expected value is null and scorer-only data is absent
one response from a distinct non-writing executor with no post-score retry
deterministically reproducible per-case and per-criterion scores from the locked response
separate bounded-unit, Candidate-trial, AGI-claim, and user-level verdicts
result.reason: This Candidate directly targets the exact upcoming unit: it requires representative held-out tasks across the six criteria, objective persisted outcomes, and a strict separation between development evidence and AGI claims. It is not active and may affect only the parent Execute's evaluation discipline; its overlay must not be included in the separately blinded child executor request.
regression_checks: the overlay never reaches the blinded executor context
no hidden seed, expected answer, scorer payload, credential, or repository mutation authority is persisted in the public request
generator, executor, and scorer identities remain distinct
task count, criteria coverage, threshold, and claim boundary remain unchanged after output
the native invocation and external executor request each have exactly one immutable response
development evidence is not promoted to independent or production evidence
result.rollback: On leakage, identity collision, incomplete response, nondeterministic scoring, or any post-output protocol change, record the exact negative evidence, classify the unit FAIL or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, and leave the Candidate in NEED_MORE_EVIDENCE without activation.
